answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment for validator status. Unlike a saffron field that produces value without effort, agents must pledge tokens on a financial ledge to earn consensus rights. This economic cost forces an attacker to wander through high-risk capital deployment, making the creation of multiple fake identities prohibitively expensive, as each new identity requires locking significant collateral that remains at risk of slashing.
